'''Hurdoc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he worked as a merchant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CodexHutta" /> On Hutta he owned a small stall in the market area of [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> an industrial town controlled by a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> The stall consisted of a table covered with a cloth and crates of the goods he sold, which consisted of various types of heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> As all merchants in Jiguuna were, Hurdoc was expected to pay some of his profits from his stall to one of Nem'ro's lieutenants at the crime lord's [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]].<ref name="CodexNem'roP">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nem'ro's palace}}</ref> Whilst at the stall the man wore armor himself and a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] on his hip. Hurdoc had [[Color/Legends|blonde]] hair which he wore with a braid and included a moustache, brown eyes and pale skin. His right eye had been replaced with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant sometime prior to [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hurdoc first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears as a heavy armor vendor on the planet Nal Hutta, the starting planet for players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] class.
